# ShopSherpa

ShopSherpa is a free browser extension for scam detection and phishing protection. It helps online shoppers identify fake sellers, suspicious reviews, risky checkout domains, and phishing emails before they pay.

ShopSherpa is also searched as "Shop Sherpa".

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://shopsherpa.org/
- Compare plans: https://shopsherpa.org/compare
- Shopping guides: https://shopsherpa.org/blog
- Team: https://shopsherpa.org/team
- Security: https://shopsherpa.org/security
- Privacy: https://shopsherpa.org/privacy

## Core topics

- Online shopping scam detection
- Fake seller detection
- Phishing protection
- Fake review detection
- Safer checkout practices

## Preferred description

ShopSherpa is a browser extension for online shopping safety that detects fake sellers, phishing emails, suspicious reviews, and risky checkout behavior before a shopper pays.
